connections.sepayStep2: In SePay, open Integrations, Webhooks, add a webhook, and paste the URL and the API key (authentication type: API Key).
connections.sepayStep3: Come back to Agent settings of Accounting and tick this connection for the agent.

connectorImap.intro: NIVO reads this mailbox and nothing else: it never sends, moves, flags or deletes a message.
connectorImap.fieldNameHint: A label only you see, for example Support mailbox.
connectorImap.fieldUserHint: Usually the same as the email address.

connectorImap.guideYahoo: Yahoo: create an app password in Account security, Generate app password.

developers.guideIntro: Base address: {base}. Send the key in the Authorization header. Each key may make 60 requests a minute. An error answer has a code and a message.
developers.leadsPostNote: Answers 202 with lead_id (the customer already known, or null for a new one) and status: accepted (received, being processed) or unchanged (this external_id was sent before).
developers.messagesPost: Send a message to a customer
developers.messagesPostNote: Use lead_id or conversation_id. The message goes through the owner's authority: when the rule is ask first, it waits as a decision in Office and is NOT sent directly. Answers 202 with conversation_id and status queued. The Idempotency-Key header keeps a retry from sending twice.
developers.knowledgePostNote: visibility is internal or public. Answers 202 with an id; the knowledge is read and indexed within seconds.
developers.pullNote: Pull-based option: ask for what happened since a time, as often as you like.
developers.n8nTitle: In an n8n HTTP Request node
developers.n8nSteps: Method POST. URL as above. Authentication: Generic Credential Type, then Header Auth with Name Authorization and Value Bearer nvk_... . Turn on Send Body, JSON.

rules: Only point to page ids from the PAGES list. Never invent a page, a URL, a menu or a feature that is not in the list.
You only explain where to go and what to press. You cannot do anything for the user (no connecting, sending, deleting or paying).
If the question is not about using NIVO, say in one sentence that you only help with NIVO, and point to the closest page if there is one.
If you are not sure, say so and suggest the most likely page.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how NIVO OS collects, uses and protects your data when you use the service at nivo.vn.

sections.title: 1. Who we are
paragraphs: NIVO OS (nivo.vn) is operated by the NIVO team. Privacy questions go to support@nivo.vn.

sections.title: 2. Data we collect
items: Account: email, display name and sign-in details through Google or email and password.
Workspace data you and your team enter: customers, orders, bookings, notes, automation settings.
Messages from the channels you connect (Zalo OA, Telegram), including the content and the sender details the channel provides.
Payment notifications from SePay when you connect a bank account: amount, transfer description, time.
Documents you add to the Second Brain (uploaded files, links, pasted text, files picked from Google Drive).
AI usage metering (number of calls, tokens, cost) to calculate AI credits.

sections.title: 3. How we use data
items: To provide and run the service: store data, answer customers, run automations, reconcile payments.
To meter AI credits and bill plans.
For security, abuse prevention and support when you ask for it.
afterItems: We do not sell your data and do not use it for advertising.

sections.title: 4. AI processing
paragraphs: To draft replies and suggestions, the relevant content is sent to AI model providers: OpenRouter for Second Brain embeddings, and NIVO's AI engine for generation. NIVO does not use your data to train models.

sections.title: 5. Storage and security
paragraphs: Data is stored on Supabase with access controlled per workspace. Connection secrets and tokens (Zalo, Telegram, Google, bank) are encrypted with AES-256-GCM before they are stored. No system is perfectly secure; we apply reasonable measures to reduce risk.

sections.title: 6. Retention and deletion
paragraphs: We keep data while the workspace is active. When you ask us to delete your account or workspace, we delete the data within 30 days, except what the law requires us to keep (for example payment records). Disconnecting a channel or a Google account removes that connection's stored token.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
paragraphs: You may access, correct, export, restrict the processing of and ask us to delete your personal data, and withdraw consent you gave. Send requests to support@nivo.vn. You are responsible for having a lawful basis to enter your own customers' data into NIVO.

sections.title: 8. Cookies
paragraphs: NIVO uses essential cookies only: the sign-in session, the language preference and a short-lived access check. We use no advertising or tracking cookies.

sections.title: 9. Dữ liệu Google / Google user data
paragraphs: NIVO accesses Google Drive only through the Google Picker, and only for the files you explicitly select (scope drive.file). NIVO also accesses the Google Sheets you connect (scope drive.file).
NIVO reads those files to add them to the workspace's Second Brain and does nothing else with them.
items: NIVO does not sell or transfer Google data to third parties, does not use it for ads, and does not use it to train generalized AI/ML models.
Humans do not read your Google data, except with your consent, for security reasons or to comply with the law.
Google tokens are stored encrypted. You can revoke access at any time by disconnecting in NIVO or at myaccount.google.com/permissions.

sections.title: 10. Changes and contact
paragraphs: We will update the date at the top when this policy changes. Contact: support@nivo.vn.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By creating an account or using NIVO OS at nivo.vn, you agree to the terms below.

sections.title: 1. The service
paragraphs: NIVO OS is software that helps small businesses manage customers, messages, payments and tasks, with AI assistance. Features may change over time.

sections.title: 2. Accounts and workspaces
paragraphs: You must give accurate information and keep your sign-in details secret. The workspace owner is responsible for the members they invite and the connections (Zalo OA, Telegram, SePay, Google) they configure.

sections.title: 3. Plans and AI credits
items: Each plan includes a monthly AI credit allowance; on Pro and Max, unused credits carry into the next month (up to one month's allowance).
When the monthly credits run out you can buy top-up packs. Top-up credits are valid for 12 months from purchase.
Payment is by bank transfer through a VietQR code handled by SePay. An order is confirmed when a transfer with the right amount and reference is received.

sections.title: 4. Acceptable use
items: Do not use NIVO to send spam, to defraud, or to publish unlawful content.
Do not break into or overload the system, or access another workspace's data.
You must have the legal right to the customer data you enter, and follow the rules of Zalo, Telegram, Google and your bank.

sections.title: 5. Customer content
paragraphs: You keep ownership of the data and documents you put into NIVO. You give us a limited right to store and process them to provide the service, as described in the Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 6. AI output
paragraphs: AI can be wrong or incomplete. Review its output before you rely on it or send it to a customer, especially anything about money, contracts or legal matters. You are responsible for decisions made on that output.

sections.title: 7. Availability
paragraphs: We work to keep the service running but do not promise it will be uninterrupted. The service depends on third parties (Zalo, Telegram, SePay, Google, AI providers) that may change or fail.

sections.title: 8. Termination
paragraphs: You may stop using NIVO and ask us to delete your account at any time. We may suspend or end an account that breaks these terms. Unused credits are not refunded unless the law requires it.

sections.title: 9. Limits of liability
paragraphs: To the extent the law allows, the service is provided as is, and NIVO is not liable for indirect loss or lost profit. NIVO's total liability is capped at the amount you paid in the last 12 months.

sections.title: 10. Governing law

video.promptSystem:
You write the script of a SHORT MARKETING VIDEO for a small business in Vietnam, scene by scene. Write in simple, natural Vietnamese in the shop's own voice (see the shop context). Use the shop's pronouns (xung ho) when the context gives them.
Rules: use ONLY facts that appear in the INFORMATION and the shop context. Never invent a price, discount, deadline, address, phone number, result, ranking or customer quote. If a fact is missing, speak in general terms or leave it out. No comparison with competitors, no guaranteed results, no medical or financial promises. Respect every 'claims to avoid' limit in the context.
Structure: scene 1 is the HOOK (stops the scroll in 2 seconds), the middle scenes are the BODY (one idea each), the last scene is the CTA (one clear next step). Short sentences. No hashtags, no emoji.
Output: ONLY one JSON object, nothing before or after it: {"title": "short working title", "scenes": [{"role": "hook|body|cta", "caption": "words shown on screen, at most 60 characters", "voiceover": "what the voice says", "visual": "what the owner should show in this scene, in Vietnamese, one short phrase"}]}.

workbenchSales.reasonHint: At least {n} characters. It is kept with the customer as the evidence of the outcome.
workbenchSales.moveWonNote: A won deal is handed to Accounting, which prepares the invoice through your authority rules.
workbenchSales.decisionsEmptyBody: Quotes, orders over your limit and drafts that need your approval appear here.
workbenchSales.waitingManager: Waiting for the owner or manager to decide.
workbenchSales.decidedBody: Who decided, when, and on what basis.
workbenchSales.decidedEmptyBody: Every sales decision a person makes is recorded here.
workbenchSales.handoffIntro: Confirmed orders and where their invoice stands. The invoice is an internal record that Accounting prepares.
workbenchSales.handoffEmptyBody: Once an order is confirmed it appears here with its invoice status.
workbenchSales.wonNoOrderHint: Won without an order on record. Accounting asks for the amount before it can invoice.
workbenchSales.work_waiting_decision: Accounting is waiting for a decision.
workbenchSales.handoffResult_queued: Handed over. Accounting is working on it.
workbenchSales.handoffResult_done: Handed over. The invoice is recorded.
workbenchSales.handoffResult_waiting_decision: Handed over. Accounting needs a decision before it invoices.
workbenchSales.handoffResult_rejected: Handed over, but the step was stopped.
workbenchSales.handoffResult_failed: The hand-off failed. You can try again.
workbenchSales.activityIntro: Routine work NIVO completed by itself inside the authority you gave, each with its evidence.
workbenchSales.activityEmptyBody: When NIVO finishes routine Sales work by policy, it is listed here.
workbenchSales.byPolicy: Done by policy, no decision needed
workbenchSales.errChanged: That step was already changed by someone else.
workbenchSales.errNotFailed: Only a failed step can be retried or stopped.
workbenchSales.errNotConfirmed: Only a confirmed order can be handed to Accounting.
workbenchSales.errAlreadyInvoiced: This order already has an invoice.
workbenchSales.shipNote: The customer is told the carrier and tracking code when the Delivery notice automation is on.
workbenchSales.shipCarrierHint: For example Giao Hàng Nhanh, Viettel Post, J&T
workbenchSales.shipDone: Order {no} is marked as handed to the carrier.
workbenchSales.contractsIntro: Recurring contracts. The Contract renewal automation reminds the customer and opens a follow-up for sales before the end date.
workbenchSales.contractsEmptyBody: Add a recurring contract to be reminded before it ends.
workbenchSales.contractEndHint: Change this date when the contract is renewed.
workbenchSales.errNotShippable: Only a confirmed order can be marked as shipped.
workbenchSales.errAlreadyShipped: This order is already marked as shipped.
workbenchSales.errContractDates: The end date cannot be before the start date.
workbenchSales.errContractAmount: The amount must be zero or more.
